Let \(f: [2,10] \to [-8.6,5]\) be the function defined by
\(f{\left(x \right)} = - x + \frac{14}{x}\).
Verify that \(f\) is bijective, and compute the inverse function \(f^{-1}:[-8.6,5] \to [2,10]\).
You may type sqrt(2) for the square root of 2 for example.
